name: text-list-v1
status: v1 (2026-10-19): the tiktok-list text style approved by the author ("ну вот щас мне нравится") after the text-style research; the first Video was "Офис — нишевые слова для парня" (built by hand before the Format existed)
audience: a man (18–60+) scrolling Reels who stops for a pretty, self-ironic woman; the joke is relatable and gets sent to friends
_doc: Style profile of the Text list Format (ADR 0009): one full profile, nothing inherited from the root style.json. No composer reads it yet: a Text list is built by hand with overlays/render.mjs (one overlay spec with this file as style_path and preset tiktok-list) plus ffmpeg; cf.render_check --format text-list reads canvas and audio.music false (a silent track passes). Pixel numbers except canvas.width/height are 1080-wide reference px (x2 at 2160x3840).

portrait.note: the only canvas: a Text list is vertical

safe_zone.source: Meta Ads Guide 14% top / 35% bottom; sides 130 px, not Meta's 6% (65 px): Instagram on a tall phone (iPhone 19.5:9; her screenshot is 920x2000) shows a 9:16 Reel full-screen by height and crops (1 - (920/2000)/(9/16))/2 = 9.1% off each side, about 98 px at 1080; 98 px crop + 32 px margin = 130. Found on her post "Офис — нишевые слова для парня" (2026-10-19): the left edge of the list was cut off ('niche' lost its n, the numbers 1)-9) were cut)

typography.preset_note: TikTok Sans SemiBold 600, white, lowercase, 4-px round black outline (#000), no shadow, no box (overlays/src/presets.ts). The lines before the blank line are the title (64 px, line height 1.12), then +24 px, then the items (56 px, line height 1.14; a spec size down to 48 for a long list). Left at x 140, right edge <= 950. Research: ~/Movies/content-factory/research/text-style-2026-10.md

items.number_column: each item's "N)" right-aligned in a column as wide as "10)", so every item's text starts on one vertical (preset tiktok-list, role numCol; approved 2026-10-20)

text.tone: deadpan list: every line is a punch; no exclamation marks
text.source: a list adapted from a concrete reference, localized into natural English (not translated)

items.note: a numbered list '1) …'; more than ~10 lines does not fit above the bottom 35 %

text.anchor_note: left-aligned at x 140 (safe_zone.left 130 + 10 px for the outline), right edge <= 950, top >= 14 % of the height, the whole list above the bottom 35 %, off her face (pick the anchor off the frames)

key_word.note: every line, the title included, colours exactly one key word or phrase: {words|<colour>}; the colours cycle through palette_cycle, line by line, with the same black outline

colors.key_words_note: the key word's fill; the black outline stays

overlay_positions._units: reference px; render.mjs needs every role, a Text list uses only 'line'

animation.note: the whole list is on screen from frame 0 to the last frame; no fades, no line-by-line reveal

pacing.note: one continuous take of her, long enough to read the whole list

footage.source: her own footage: one calm take the author picks from a board (the Editor shows 3–6 candidates)
footage.rule: posed or seated shots read better under a list than walking (author)

color.rule: original colour, as on the Mac: an HDR Clip through its Apple SDR mezzanine (cf.mezz), an SDR one raw; no grade, no Look

audio.note: no music: the author adds the sound in Instagram; render_check passes the silent track

ending.note: the take simply ends; the list stays on to the last frame

caption.note: one short deadpan line in English that plays off the list (one emoji at most), up to 5 hashtags

reframe.note: the take fills the canvas with a centred crop (a portrait clip just scales)

render.engine: by hand: overlays/render.mjs for the list, ffmpeg for the compose (no composer yet)
